Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Hanes
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/08/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 172 as introduced amends the Alabama Memorial Preservation Act to revise the amount of fine that may be levied for violation of the act from $25,000 per violation, currently, to $10,000 per day that the violation continues.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
